description: This PHP source file defines the I18NService class, which handles internationalization and translation management in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching, caching, and translating messages for different languages, as well as generating cache keys and managing resource loading.

classes.name: I18NService
classes.description: Main service class for managing internationalization, translation caching, resource loading, and translation operations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getI18NDao
methods.description: Lazy loads or returns the I18NDao data access object used for fetching translation messages from the database.

methods.name: addLanguage
methods.description: Marks a language-resource combination as loaded, preventing duplicate resource loading.

methods.name: isLanguageLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a language-resource combination has already been loaded.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Generates the cache key prefix for a given language code.

methods.name: generateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for storing translation messages JSON for a specific language.

methods.name: generateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for storing key-target translation array for a specific language.

methods.name: generateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for storing source-target translation array for a specific language.

methods.name: generateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Creates cache key for the ETag associated with a language's translations.

methods.name: getTranslationCollection
methods.description: Fetches all translation messages for a specified language from the database and organizes them into a TranslationCollection object.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonStringAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves all translation messages for a language as a JSON string, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Generates and retrieves the ETag for a language's translations, with caching.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Public method to fetch all translation messages in JSON format for a specific language, with ETag check.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Retrieves the key-target translation pairs as an array for a specific language, with cache management.

methods.name: getTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Retrieves the source-target translation array for a specific language, with cache management.

methods.name: cleanAndRefetchIfCacheNotHit
methods.description: Refetches cache if a cache miss occurs for translation data, and clears related cache entries.

methods.name: getETagByLangCode
methods.description: Retrieves or generates the ETag for the translations of a given language code.

methods.name: getTranslator
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Symfony Translator instance configured with default locale and loader.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language (locale) for the Translator instance.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a given key into the current language, loading resources if necessary.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source string into the current language.

methods.name: clearCacheByLangCode
methods.description: Clears all cache entries for a specific language code.
